hero.description: Synapse turns your conversations into a knowledge graph. People, places, goals, emotions, patterns. All structured, all connected. An AI that learns who you are, not just what you said last.

pullQuote: "I needed a space that remembers my patterns, not just my words. Synapse doesn't start over every time. It notices when I'm spiraling the same way I did last month — and helps me catch it earlier."

comparison.title: Context changes everything
comparison.description: Same conversation. One AI has context, the other doesn't. The difference is obvious.

regular.text: I had a terrible day. Everything feels overwhelming again.
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you tried taking some deep breaths or going for a walk? Sometimes a change of scenery helps.
I told you last week this keeps happening after meetings with my boss...
I don't have context from previous conversations. Can you tell me more about what's going on with your boss?

synapse.text: I had a terrible day. Everything feels overwhelming again.
I hear you. The last three times you've described this 'everything crashing' feeling, it followed tense interactions with David. Did something happen in today's meeting?
Yes. He dismissed my proposal in front of everyone. Again.

That pattern of public dismissal has been a consistent trigger for you — it connects to the authority dynamics we've explored before. Last time, the body scan helped you move from shutdown back to your window. Want to try that now, or do you need to just be angry first?

pipeline.title: Memory engineering, not memorization
pipeline.description: Four steps from conversation to structured knowledge.

steps.title: Converse
steps.desc: Talk about your day, your goals, your worries. Every session gets captured automatically.

steps.title: Ingest
steps.desc: Sessions are processed through Graphiti, extracting entities and relationships into Neo4j.

steps.title: Compile
steps.desc: Your knowledge graph is compiled and injected into future sessions as structured context.

steps.title: Evolve
steps.desc: Each conversation refines the graph. The more you talk, the better it gets.

personas.title: Different needs, one memory
personas.description: Every companion reads the same knowledge graph but brings a different lens. Therapeutic depth, gentle reflection, or practical momentum.

list.name: Compass
list.desc: Tracks your emotional patterns across conversations. Connects today's anxiety to recurring triggers. Uses ACT and DBT to help you build flexibility, not just cope.

list.name: Solace
list.desc: A gentle space for daily reflection. Notices shifts in your mood and energy over time. Draws on self-compassion and mindfulness to help you stay grounded.

list.name: Momentum
list.desc: Holds you accountable to the goals you've set. Knows what derails you and what works. Uses motivational interviewing to keep you moving without burning out.

transparency.title: You see everything it knows
transparency.description: The Memory Explorer shows your full knowledge graph. Inspect it, correct it, or delete from it. You're always in control.

features.title: Explore your graph
features.desc: Interactive visualization of every entity and relationship in your graph.

features.title: Correct in plain English
features.desc: "I left TechCorp." The graph updates. No forms, no menus.

features.title: Fully open source
features.desc: The entire codebase is public. See how it works, fork it, contribute.

features.title: Export to Notion
features.desc: Sync your graph to Notion. Review offline. Push corrections back.

cta.description: Start talking. The graph builds itself. The AI gets better the more you use it.

therapist.name: Compass
therapist.description: Therapeutic companion grounded in ACT, DBT, and Polyvagal Theory. Neuroaffirmative by default.

wellbeing.name: Solace
wellbeing.description: Gentle emotional support through Positive Psychology, self-compassion, and mindfulness.

coach.name: Momentum
coach.description: Growth-focused coach using Motivational Interviewing and behavioral strategies.
